events.headline: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley arranged a $63B financing package (banks weighing ~$21B in bonds) for a special-purpose vehicle to buy Broadcom XPU AI accelerators and networking gear and lease them to Anthropic; Anthropic filed its S-1 to list on Nasdaq (ticker ANT) on Oct 26. Broadcom rose ~3-4%, AMD/Nvidia edged higher, CoreWeave jumped ~8% on Oct 27

Brent crude hit roughly $115/bbl on Oct 23, its highest since June 2022, as traders priced in reported US/Israeli plans for renewed strikes on Iran after the US midterms, continued Houthi attacks on Saudi energy and military targets, and a State Department evacuation order for non-essential personnel in Saudi Arabia

A Reuters poll (94/100 economists) and CME FedWatch pricing (~83-91% odds) point to the Fed holding its benchmark rate at 3.75%-4.00% at the Oct 27-28 FOMC meeting concluding today, though markets see materially higher odds (~70%+) of a hike resuming in December given still-elevated inflation

China's suspension of expanded export controls on rare-earth and lithium-battery materials is set to lapse November 10, 2026 with no extension yet announced, leaving chip and battery supply chains exposed to renewed curbs within weeks
